Let's proceed by writing a test that targets the `GetStoreOptions` method, specifically the call to `sp.GetService<IEmbeddingGenerator>()`. Since the method is private, I will assume that the public methods that call it are the entry points to test this behavior indirectly.

The key method that calls `GetStoreOptions` is `AddQdrantVectorStore` and `AddKeyedQdrantVectorStore`. I will write a test that:

- Sets up a service collection
- Adds a mock `IServiceProvider` that returns a mock `IEmbeddingGenerator` when `GetService<IEmbeddingGenerator>()` is called
- Calls `AddQdrantVectorStore` with this setup
- Verifies that the options returned include the `EmbeddingGenerator`

I'll need to mock the `IServiceProvider` and `IEmbeddingGenerator`, then verify the behavior.

Let's proceed with the test implementation.

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Qdrant;
using System;

namespace Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Tests
{
    public class QdrantServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void GetStoreOptions_ReturnsOptionsWithEmbeddingGenerator_WhenProvided()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var mockOptions = new QdrantVectorStoreOptions();
            var mockGenerator = new Mock<IEmbeddingGenerator>();
            var optionsWithGenerator = new QdrantVectorStoreOptions { EmbeddingGenerator = mockGenerator.Object };

            // Act
            var result = QdrantServiceCollectionExtensions.GetStoreOptions(
                new ServiceProviderStub(new[] { (typeof(IEmbeddingGenerator), mockGenerator.Object) }),
                sp => optionsWithGenerator);

            // Assert
            Assert.Equal(optionsWithGenerator, result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void GetStoreOptions_ReturnsOptionsWithoutGenerator_WhenGeneratorNotAvailable()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            // Act
            var result = QdrantServiceCollectionExtensions.GetStoreOptions(
                new ServiceProviderStub(),
                sp => null);

            // Assert
            Assert.Null(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void GetStoreOptions_ReturnsNewOptionsWithGenerator_WhenGeneratorIsAvailable()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var mockGenerator = new Mock<IEmbeddingGenerator>();
            var options = new QdrantVectorStoreOptions();

            var sp = new ServiceProviderStub(new[] { (typeof(IEmbeddingGenerator), mockGenerator.Object) });

            // Act
            var result = QdrantServiceCollectionExtensions.GetStoreOptions(sp, sp => options);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.Equal(mockGenerator.Object, result.EmbeddingGenerator);
        }
    }

    // A simple stub for IServiceProvider to simulate service resolution
    public class ServiceProviderStub : IServiceProvider
    {
        private readonly (Type type, object instance)[] _services;

        public ServiceProviderStub((Type type, object instance)[] services = null)
        {
            _services = services ?? Array.Empty<(Type, object)>();
        }

        public object GetService(Type serviceType)
        {
            foreach (var (type, instance) in _services)
            {
                if (type == serviceType)
                {
                    return instance;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData;
using System;

namespace Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Tests
{
    public class QdrantServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void GetStoreOptions_ReturnsOptionsWithEmbeddingGenerator_WhenGeneratorIsRegistered()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var mockGenerator = new Mock<IEmbeddingGenerator>();
            var options = new QdrantVectorStoreOptions();

            // Build a service provider with IEmbeddingGenerator registered
            var provider = services.AddTransient<IEmbeddingGenerator>(_ => mockGenerator.Object).BuildServiceProvider();

            // Act
            var result = QdrantServiceCollectionExtensions.GetStoreOptions(provider, sp => null);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.Null(result.EmbeddingGenerator);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void GetStoreOptions_ReturnsOptionsWithGenerator_WhenGeneratorIsAvailableInServiceProvider()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var mockGenerator = new Mock<IEmbeddingGenerator>();
            services.AddTransient<IEmbeddingGenerator>(_ => mockGenerator.Object);
            var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            var options = new QdrantVectorStoreOptions();

            // Act
            var result = QdrantServiceCollectionExtensions.GetStoreOptions(provider, sp => options);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.Equal(mockGenerator.Object, result.EmbeddingGenerator);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void GetStoreOptions_ReturnsOriginalOptions_WhenGeneratorIsNull()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            var options = new QdrantVectorStoreOptions();

            // Act
            var result = QdrantServiceCollectionExtensions.GetStoreOptions(provider, sp => null);

            // Assert
            Assert.Equal(options, result);
        }
    }

    // A simple stub for IServiceProvider to simulate service resolution
    public class ServiceProviderStub : IServiceProvider
    {
        private readonly Func<Type, object> _resolver;

        public ServiceProviderStub(Func<Type, object> resolver)
        {
            _resolver = resolver;
        }

        public object GetService(Type serviceType)
        {
            return _resolver(serviceType);
        }
    }
}
